The Messages API also accepts the marker on a `text` sub-block of a `tool_result`'s list content. That shape is not seen as marked, so the `tool_res... workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Multi-block list-form tool_result is flattened with "", fusing the last line of one block with the first line of the next
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(content-router): keep list-form tool_result text blocks on separate lines. Target files: headroom/transforms/content_router.py, tests/test_transforms/test_content_router.py. A `tool_result` whose `content` is a list of several `text` blocks gets flattened with `"".join(...)` in `ContentRouter` before the read-protection check and before compression. MCP tools that return more than one `TextContent` and litellm-style clients send this shape. When a block does not end with a newline, the last line of one block and... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4739)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Kompress drops Python keywords from a fenced code block inside a mixed tool result
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(router): keep source code out of the prose (Kompress) fallbacks. Target files: crates/headroom-core/src/transforms/code_compressor.rs, crates/headroom-core/src/transforms/live_zone.rs, headroom/transforms/content_router.py. When the code compressor declined a block of source code, the router passed the block to Kompress. Kompress is a prose model. It drops low-salience words, and in code those words are keywords such as `for`, `in`, `if` and `import`. The result no longer parses. #4214 shows a fenced Python scri... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4787)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Lossless search fold still splits Go, nginx, klog and access-log timestamps into fake grep headers
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(lossless): never grep-fold Go, nginx, klog or access-log timestamps. Target files: headroom/transforms/lossless_compaction.py, tests/test_bash_search_lossless_fold.py, tests/test_lossless_timestamp_guard.py. The lossless search fold splits each line as `path:line:content` and factors a repeated `path` into a header. `_TIMESTAMP_ROW_RE` (#3419) keeps timestamped log lines out of it, because a log line has the same colon shape: folding it hoists the date and hour into a fake file header and every row starts mid-cl... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4901)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(opencode): percent-encode the project name in x-headroom-project. Target files: headroom/providers/opencode/_dist/index.js, headroom/providers/opencode/hook-shim/handler.js, plugins/opencode/src/plugin.ts. A header value must be a ByteString, so a project name with any character above U+00FF (Thai, Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic, `€`, emoji and so on) made `Head... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4780)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] OpenCode plugin: after #4758 a POST to a non-LLM API with a bare /messages path (for example MessageBird) is still rerouted to the proxy
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(opencode): stop routing a host's bare /messages or /responses to the proxy (#4781). Target files: headroom/providers/opencode/_dist/index.js, headroom/providers/opencode/hook-shim/handler.js, plugins/opencode/src/transport.test.ts. A `POST` whose path ends in a wire endpoint but that sits at a host's origin root (`/messages`, `/responses`, `/chat/completions`) is no longer routed to the proxy unless that origin is a configured provider base URL. (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4791)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] TypeScript SDK client.compress retries and swallows typed 4xx errors from the proxy

When the proxy's error body has a typed `error.type`, `mapProxyError` returns `ConfigurationError`, `ValidationError` and so on, so those 4xx responses were retried and, with the default `fallback: true`, turned into an uncompressed result. workarounds.symptom: [BUG] headroom-oauth2: a misconfigured install() is skipped by the extension loader, so the proxy starts without the middleware although SPEC.md says it fails closed
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): let an extension declare its install() fail-closed (#4737). (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4773)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Subscription `toin_read_only` policy is not honoured on two TOIN write paths (router -> SmartCrusher.crush, and Kompress CCR store)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(transforms): honour Subscription toin_read_only when the router calls SmartCrusher. Target files: headroom/transforms/content_router.py, headroom/transforms/smart_crusher.py, tests/test_compression_policy_toin_gate.py. Subscription requests still wrote observations to the shared TOIN store when the `ContentRouter` compressed a JSON array with SmartCrusher. `CompressionPolicy.toin_read_only` says Subscription traffic must never write to TOIN (`compression_policy.py`). (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4493)
